name: Obscura Headless Browser for AI Agents (CDP)
description: Token-protected Rust headless browser with stealth mode, for Playwright.

upstream.obscura: h4ckf0r0day/obscura v0.2.6 (released 2026-10-31), prebuilt -stealth Linux release archives, SHA-256 pinned
upstream.node: Node.js 24.22.3 LTS (2026-11-10), nodejs.org tarball, SHA-256 pinned

OBSCURA_TOKEN.description: Access token, generated at deploy. Send it as ?token=, Authorization: Bearer or Basic auth password. 16+ chars of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ ~ -

PORT.description: Port of the token gate (healthcheck and public domain target). Obscura itself listens on 127.0.0.1:9222 only.

OBSCURA_STEALTH.description: true: browser-matching TLS fingerprint, consistent browser profile and a tracker blocklist (about 3,500 domains). Off by default, as upstream. Does not solve CAPTCHAs.

OBSCURA_WORKERS.description: Obscura worker processes (1-32). More than 1 spreads connections over processes and restarts a crashed one without stopping the others.

OBSCURA_BLOCK_PRIVATE_NETWORKS.description: Block pages from reaching private, loopback and link-local addresses (Railway private network, metadata IP). Set false only to browse your own private services.

OBSCURA_MAX_SESSIONS.description: Maximum open CDP WebSocket connections; more get HTTP 429. 0 = unlimited.

OBSCURA_IDLE_TIMEOUT.description: Close a CDP connection after this many seconds without traffic in either direction. 0 = never.

OBSCURA_SESSION_TIMEOUT.description: Maximum lifetime of a CDP connection in seconds, idle or not. 0 = unlimited.

OBSCURA_PROXY.description: Optional outbound proxy for all page traffic, e.g. http://user:pass@host:8080 or socks5://host:1080.

OBSCURA_LOG_LEVEL.description: Obscura log level: error, warn, info, debug, trace or off. The gate always logs sessions at info.

OBSCURA_EXTRA_ARGS.description: Optional extra flags for obscura serve, quoted like a shell, e.g. --user-agent "MyAgent/1.0" or --obey-robots. --host and --port are reserved.

BROWSER_TOKEN.description: Alias of OBSCURA_TOKEN under the name Railway's Browserless templates use.

BROWSER_WS_ENDPOINT.description: Public CDP WebSocket URL for Playwright connectOverCDP or Puppeteer browserWSEndpoint. Reference as ${{Obscura.BROWSER_WS_ENDPOINT}}.

BROWSER_WS_ENDPOINT_PRIVATE.description: CDP WebSocket URL over Railway's private network (no egress). Reference as ${{Obscura.BROWSER_WS_ENDPOINT_PRIVATE}} from services in this project.
